jobs.title: AI / Cloud Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Accelerate enterprise AI computing workflows by building resilient full-stack deployment services, containerized model APIs, and developer tools.
jobs.requirements: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or Software Engineering. Hands-on experience with RESTful microservices, asynchronous execution, and modern cloud deployment.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a proactive Full-Stack Engineer to design, build, and deploy high-performance web applications and cloud microservices. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable backend services and responsive front-end experiences.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent. 2+ years of hands-on experience with modern JavaScript frameworks and server-side runtimes. Strong grasp of asynchronous programming and database design.

jobs.title: Frontend React Developer
jobs.description: Join our front-end customer experience team to develop intuitive, accessible, and high-performance cloud management interfaces. You will build reusable component systems and optimize client-side rendering.
jobs.requirements: Strong proficiency in React, HTML5, CSS3, and modern browser APIs. Experience building responsive layouts and integrating RESTful APIs. Knowledge of state management and web accessibility standards.

jobs.title: Backend API Developer
jobs.description: Build high-throughput, low-latency microservices powering global cloud commerce. You will design secure RESTful APIs, manage persistent storage layers, and monitor system performance.
jobs.requirements: Proven track record with Node.js and Express. In-depth understanding of database optimization, API security (JWT, CORS, rate limiting), and cloud containerization.

jobs.title: UI/UX Product Designer
jobs.description: Craft delightful user journeys, interactive wireframes, and production-ready design systems for millions of creators worldwide. Work closely with product managers and engineers.
jobs.requirements: Strong portfolio showcasing web and mobile interface designs. Proficiency in Figma and design token workflows. Excellent communication and empathy for end users.

jobs.title: Web Development Intern
jobs.description: Great learning opportunity for final-year students and freshers! Assist senior engineers in building customer-facing modules, fixing UI bugs, and testing web applications.
jobs.requirements: Enrolled in or graduated with a Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT, or Software Engineering. Eagerness to learn full-stack technologies and good problem-solving mindset.
